$comment: Experiment cards. Each one tests a revenue model against a real economy with a single metric and a kill rule. `results` stays empty until a receipt (ledger row, analytics export, MoR report) exists; the validator rejects a result without `receipt`. Spend budgets are 0 because agents stage and humans execute money actions (Doctrine 0).

experiments.title: Do agents convert better than readers?
experiments.hypothesis: Partner recommendations served through the /api/mcp fit_check tool produce more go.agenticincome.ai clicks per 100 sessions than the same recommendations on a comparison page.
experiments.metric: go.agenticincome.ai clicks per 100 sessions, split by `src=mcp` vs `src=page`
experiments.baseline: [OPEN] needs 14 days of router logs with the src tag
experiments.killRule: Fewer than 30 MCP-sourced clicks after 28 days: stop and fold the effort into page content.
build: add src tag to MCP tool links

experiments.title: Is the vault worth paying for?
experiments.hypothesis: Builders will join a waitlist for a monthly sourced digital-economy brief (the vault, refreshed) at a stated price band.
experiments.metric: waitlist signups with price band selected, via starlight/packages/demand-capture
experiments.killRule: Fewer than 25 signups, or fewer than 5 choosing the paid band, after 21 days.
build: sample issue built from vault data

experiments.title: Marketplace reach or own checkout?
experiments.hypothesis: The same creator skill pack gets more installs from a public Claude Code plugin marketplace listing than from its gencreator.ai page in the same period.
experiments.metric: installs (marketplace) vs waitlist signups (own page), weekly
experiments.killRule: Marketplace listing under 20 installs in 28 days: keep own page as the primary surface.

experiments.title: Templates where template buyers already shop
experiments.hypothesis: One GenCreator template listed on an established template marketplace (Framer or Notion) earns its first sale faster than via own checkout, net of take rate.
experiments.metric: days to first sale; net revenue after take rate T
experiments.killRule: No sale in 45 days on either surface: the template is the problem, not the channel; return it to design review.

experiments.title: Will agents pay per call?
experiments.hypothesis: A single premium MCP tool (fresh, sourced partner-economics lookup) priced per call over an agent payment rail gets at least one paid call from a third-party agent.
experiments.metric: paid calls from wallets or accounts we do not control
experiments.killRule: Zero external paid calls in 60 days: keep the tool free and record the result as evidence about rail adoption.
humanGates: wallet or payout account setup (money operation, Frank executes)
build: staged rail integration in a sandbox

experiments.title: BYOK or bundled credits for creators
experiments.hypothesis: Asking creators which they prefer, bring-your-own-key or bundled credits at a stated price, shows a majority preference strong enough to set the default plan shape.
experiments.metric: waitlist choice split (BYOK vs bundled) with price band
experiments.killRule: Fewer than 40 responses: keep BYOK default (estate doctrine) and re-run with a larger audience.

experiments.title: Direct sale or streaming for Arcanea Records
experiments.hypothesis: One release offered both on a direct-sale platform and via a streaming distributor earns more per listener directly than through streams in the first 60 days.
experiments.metric: net revenue per unique listener, by channel
experiments.baseline: [OPEN] existing catalog numbers from the release ledger
experiments.killRule: Fewer than 100 unique listeners total: the release needs distribution work before channel comparison means anything.
humanGates: rights check on AI-generated audio terms

experiments.title: A pay-what-you-want micro-game from Arcanea canon
experiments.hypothesis: A small browser game set in canon, listed on an indie game storefront, brings new visitors to arcanea.ai at a measurable rate.
experiments.metric: storefront views, downloads, referral visits to arcanea.ai
experiments.killRule: Under 200 storefront views in 30 days: stop, keep the build as a canon demo.
build: store page assets with provenance sidecars

experiments.title: Sell a scraper where scraper buyers are
experiments.hypothesis: A public actor that extracts affiliate-program terms (commission, cookie window, recurring window) gets paying users on a scraper store under its developer revenue share.
humanGates: target sites' terms of service review

experiments.title: Do economy explainers earn search traffic?
experiments.hypothesis: Five sourced explainers built from vault data ('how the App Store economy pays developers', 'what an agent payment rail is') earn more search clicks per article than the current comparison posts within 60 days.
experiments.killRule: Median explainer below median comparison post at day 60.
